newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish CPI to grow 2.1 percent in 1998-Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spanish CPI to grow 2.1 percent in 1998-Rato.

text.p: Spanish CPI is expected to grow around 2.1 percent in 1998, Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Thursday.

"The government is working now with a forecast of 1998 CPI at 2.1 percent, which means that with growth above three percent as expected in 1998, we are in a time of growth and stability," Rato told Spanish Television on the fringes of a news conference in Strasbourg.
The Spanish government is now working on its 1998 budget draft. Earlier this month, Rato had announced that the budget draft would be ready for Parliament at the end of July.
For 1997, the Spanish government revised inflation down from an initial forecast ot 2.6 percent to 2.2 percent. GDP growth in 1996 is estimated at three percent.
